supporting_news.title: India bonds under pressure before debt supply; hot inflation prints pinch further
supporting_news.summary: Indian government bonds experienced significant selling pressure ahead of a major auction for the benchmark paper. The yield on the 6.94% 2036 bond rose notably due to rising inflation in both India and the United States. The Reserve Bank of India is expected to raise interest rates again in early December due to persistent inflationary pressures. Moreover, US Treasury yields remained elevated as markets anticipate larger interest rate hikes.

supporting_news.title: BofA adds January Fed hike to forecast, says quarterly pace no longer enough
supporting_news.summary: BofA Global Research anticipates that the Federal Reserve will implement a rate hike in January 2027. This adjustment follows the unexpectedly high Consumer Price Index report for October. Expectations of a 25-basis-point increase are supported by increasing inflation driven by various factors. Other banks like Goldman Sachs and Deutsche Bank have also revised their forecasts in light of recent data.

supporting_news.title: German yields set for biggest weekly rise in two months
supporting_news.summary: As traders ramp up their expectations for European Central Bank interest rate hikes, yields on German government bonds are climbing steadily. This shift follows US inflation figures that were unexpectedly high, disrupting the bond market landscape. Meanwhile, global stock indices are witnessing a downturn, impacting the demand for traditionally safe assets.
